summary: This note is the header file for the DetachableJoint system in Open Source Robotics Foundation's Gazebo simulator (gz-sim), licensed under Apache License 2.0 and copyright 2019. The system initially attaches two models with a fixed joint, then lets them be detached and re-attached during simulation via transport topics, and publishes the detachment state on an output topic. The header's doc comment lists its configurable parameters: parent_link, child_model, child_link, and optional topic, detach_topic, attach_topic, output_topic, and suppress_child_warning.
one_line: Gazebo (gz-sim) header for the DetachableJoint system, which attaches two models with a fixed joint that can be detached and re-attached via topics.
key_facts: DetachableJoint is a system that initially attaches two models via a fixed joint.
The models can be detached during simulation via a topic and re-attached during simulation via a topic.
The status of the detached state can be monitored via a topic.
The parameter <parent_link> names the link in the parent model used to create a fixed joint with a link in the child model.
The parameter <child_model> names the model to which this model will be connected.
The parameter <child_link> names the link in the child model used to create a fixed joint with a link in the parent model.
The optional parameter <detach_topic> sets the topic for detaching connections and is preferred over <topic>.
If multiple detachable plugins are used in one model, detach_topic is REQUIRED to detach child models individually.
The optional parameter <attach_topic> sets the topic for attaching connections.
The optional parameter <output_topic> sets the topic for publishing the state of the detachment.
The optional parameter <suppress_child_warning> defaults to false, meaning a warning is printed if a child model does not exist yet.
The header is copyright (C) 2019 Open Source Robotics Foundation and licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.
The class DetachableJoint inherits from System, ISystemConfigure, and ISystemPreUpdate and implements Configure and PreUpdate.
The private member detachRequested defaults to false and attachRequested defaults to true, while isAttached defaults to false.
